scope: representation repair and abstraction-sensitive anomaly diagnosis

source.screening_scope: metadata-and-abstract first pass plus manually retained direct threats
source.warning: This is an evidence index, not a claim that every cited work has been fully reproduced or that the proposed contribution is novel.

core_papers.title: Computational Models of Scientific Discovery and Theory Formation
core_papers.claim_supported: Theory formation, revision and fault diagnosis have substantial historical precedent.
core_papers.boundary: Must be read in full before making a novelty claim about theory repair.

core_papers.title: Towards Robot Scientists for autonomous scientific discovery
core_papers.authors: Andrew C. Sparkes; Wayne Aubrey; Emma Byrne; et al.
core_papers.claim_supported: Closed-loop hypothesis, experiment, interpretation and provenance are established design requirements.
core_papers.boundary: Retrieved material does not establish a cross-level representation-repair policy.

core_papers.title: Model criticism based on likelihood-free inference, with an application to protein network evolution
core_papers.authors: Oliver Ratmann; Christophe Andrieu; Carsten Wiuf; et al.
core_papers.claim_supported: Model adequacy can be tested with model-data discrepancies.
core_papers.boundary: It is not by itself a policy for choosing measurement, parameter, structural or conceptual repair.

core_papers.title: Diagnostic Measures for Model Criticism
core_papers.authors: Cinzia Carota; Giovanni Parmigiani; Nicholas G. Polson
core_papers.claim_supported: Model criticism can value elaborated alternatives while retaining prediction and parameter inference.
core_papers.boundary: A comparison point for structural expansion, not evidence for full repair-level selection.

core_papers.title: Estimating model inadequacy in ordinary differential equations with physics-informed neural networks
core_papers.authors: Felipe Viana; Renato G. Nascimento; Arinan Dourado
core_papers.claim_supported: Scientific models can be augmented with discrepancy or inadequacy estimation.
core_papers.boundary: Requires a structural-repair comparator in the eventual benchmark.

core_papers.title: Hypothesis-Driven Constructive Induction in AQ17-HCI: A Method and Experiments
core_papers.claim_supported: Feature and predicate construction have a precedent as a representation-expansion strategy.
core_papers.boundary: Does not demonstrate when representation expansion is the appropriate repair.

core_papers.title: Autonomous chemical research with large language models
core_papers.authors: Daniil A. Boiko; Robert MacKnight; Ben Kline; Gabe Gomes
core_papers.claim_supported: LLM-driven planning and laboratory/tool interaction can be organized into a constrained scientific workflow.
core_papers.boundary: Does not establish the representation-repair diagnosis evaluated here.

core_papers.title: On-the-fly closed-loop materials discovery via Bayesian active learning
core_papers.authors: A. G. Kusne; T. F. Han; et al.
core_papers.claim_supported: Closed-loop experimental design can allocate experiments using uncertainty and utility.
core_papers.boundary: Optimizes experiment selection rather than choosing a level of representation repair.

provisional_contribution: Given persistent residuals with different hidden causes, evaluate whether a scientific agent selects the correct repair level, and whether compression of residual evidence systematically increases under-revision.
required_outcomes: independent replication of the computational result
